column3: “heads of households” renders “heads of the fathers.”
“through Moses” renders “by the hand of Moses”; “cattle” renders “livestock.”
“according to the command of” renders “to the mouth of.”
“who were of the Levites” renders “of the Levites”; NASB reorders the verse.
“through Moses” renders “by the hand of Moses.”
“which are here mentioned by name” renders “which he called by name.”
NASB supplies “Arba being” and puts “that is, Hebron” in parentheses.
“were allotted” renders “were the cities of their lot.”
NASB supplies “they gave” (also in verses 30, 32, 34, 36, and 38).
